candidate.answerReason: Parallel projection uses mutually parallel rays, while central projection uses rays through one common center. This is choice B.

methods.label: Projection definitions
methods.explanation: The projection rays in parallel projection are parallel to one another (as with sunlight); the projection rays in central projection intersect at a single point (as with light from a lamp).
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the Grade 9 definitions of parallel and central projection.
